items.title: Inventory active Lattice identities, freeze historical evidence, and adopt the superseding clean-break policy
items.context: Before any production edit, inventory each active identity class (root/lab/utils package names, npm bins and wrappers, command text, role IDs, environment keys, state/config/adapter paths, runtime identifiers, hooks, prompts, and docs) and write a superseding decision with per-class canonical-write, compatibility-read, historical-verification, and residue-allowlist rules. Historical stories, legacy migration inputs, compatibility fixtures, changelog records, schemas, signature salts, and provenance/hash-bound bytes remain frozen only where byte stability is required.
items.userSees: A superseding Proof-or-Stop identity-cutover decision is present before any production migration commit, with every legacy identity classified as remove, migrate, or exact frozen evidence.
excludes: Changing signature salts or provenance-bound schemas

items.title: Commit RED regression tests for every active legacy identity class and frozen-history boundary
items.context: Before production edits, commit failing tests that cover @lattice/lab, @lattice/utils, root package identity, npm bin maps and removed wrappers, active command guidance, role/env/path/config canonical-only new writes, and active-file residue. The same RED suite must capture pre-migration historical byte/digest baselines and successful signature verification, then GREEN must prove those bytes/digests and verification results remain unchanged. The residue allowlist must be narrow, reasoned, fail closed when stale, and have mutation proof.
items.userSees: The committed cutover verifier fails on the pre-migration tree and names each active Lattice identity class, while named historical proof baselines verify successfully.
excludes: Uncommitted ad-hoc grep as the sole RED evidence

items.title: Migrate Lab, Utils, and root package identities to Proof-or-Stop
items.context: Synchronize manifests, every tracked lockfile, dependency resolution, the global Lab verifier, and packed tarballs. Do not leak unpublished file: dependencies into distributable manifests.

items.title: Remove every active lattice command entrypoint and standardize proof-or-stop CLI invocation
items.context: Bins, spawned commands, help, hints, errors, hooks, scripts, agent prompts, and examples must invoke proof-or-stop only. Keep no lattice alias or deprecated command fallback.

items.title: Migrate active runtime identities while preserving historical signatures and evidence
items.context: Move active constants, env/path/role/config identifiers to Proof-or-Stop. Signature salts, schemas, historical stories, and provenance/hash-bound content remain byte-stable; any necessary residue requires a bounded allowlist entry.

items.title: Update current source prose, verifiers, adapters, and product documentation
items.context: Update README, CLI docs, templates, adapters, and verification scripts. Preserve original historical decision statements and add a superseding decision instead of rewriting the past.

items.title: Reach GREEN with builds, package tarballs, clean installs, CLI smoke tests, and residue checks
items.context: Verify main/lab/utils builds; npm pack and clean tarball installs; proof-or-stop --version/help/lab help/lab run; doctor; entrypoint and contract verifiers. Active residue is zero and allowlisted residue is frozen evidence only.

items.title: Synchronize the patch version and complete REVIEW, TEST, and DONE convergence
items.context: This changes runtime behavior and requires a patch bump. Commit code and evidence, complete review lanes, routine validation, any DONE-required policy, done_prepare, and the local merge to main.
